clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most of us are loading our bodies with toxins all day without realizing it.

His list: showering without a filter (your skin absorbs whatever touches it), the water you drink, coffee, tea, soda, energy drinks, and even food that looks fine but is conventionally grown.

His point: it adds up every single day, and most people never clear it back out.

His simple fix: reduce what you're taking in before you worry about anything else.

Comment HEALTH and we'll send you where to start.

#kevintrudeau #toxins #waterfiltration #wbdaily #healthtruth #naturalhealth

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of how one genetically modified tomato actually gets made.

His claim: scientists took a pig gene and put it inside the tomato seed itself, so the plant wards off a bug on its own, without a spray.

Then, he says, they took the weed poison from Monsanto and built that into the seed too, so it comes up from inside the plant instead of being sprayed on top.

His point: nature already made a working tomato. Science just patented a new one to sell.
